definitions: To adjust something precisely or to fine-tune it.
To connect to a computer system or network using a modem and a telephone line.
To focus or concentrate on a task or goal.
examples: We need to dial in the settings for optimal performance.
I used to dial in to the internet every night.
She really dialed in her focus for the exam.
pastTenses: dialed in (simple past), dialed in (present perfect)
